# Learning vault

This is an Obsidian vault used for studying. When pi runs here, the learning
workflow applies — see `Learning/Dashboard.md` for what is currently due.

## Conventions

| Folder | Contents | Who writes it |
|---|---|---|
| `Learning/Sources/` | Longform reading notes, messy by design | Me |
| `Learning/Cheatsheets/` | One compressed, quizzable note per topic | The `cheatsheet` skill |
| `Learning/Sessions/` | Transcripts of learning sessions | The `learn` extension |
| `Learning/Gaps/` | Current knowledge-gap reports | The `gaps` skill |
| `Learning/Maps/` | Diagrams and dependency graphs | Generated |
| `Learning/LEARNER.md` | What to assume I already know | Me |

## Rules

- Read `Learning/LEARNER.md` before teaching anything. Do not re-explain what
  it says I already hold.
- Maths in `$...$` / `$$...$$`, links as `[[wikilinks]]`.
- Never edit the frontmatter scheduling fields of a cheatsheet by hand
  (`ease`, `interval_days`, `reps`, `lapses`, `last_quizzed`, `next_review`,
  `mastery`) — `review_close` owns them.
- Never edit my notes in `Sources/`. Suggest changes; do not apply them.
- Every graded question goes through the `quiz` tool, never as chat text.
